name: Xiaomi
description: Xiaomi is a consumer-electronics and smart-manufacturing company with its campus/corporate address in Beijing, China. Smartphones and AIoT products are at its core; its mission is to build amazing products with honest prices so everyone can enjoy a better life through innovative technology.

sources.notes: Xiaomi's official investor-relations contacts page lists Xiaomi Campus on Anningzhuang Road, Haidian District, Beijing, China.
Xiaomi's official terms list the registered office of Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd. in Haidian District, Beijing.

verification.notes: Location metadata verified from Xiaomi's official investor and legal pages; the broader catalogue record was not re-audited.
